forkAgentDesc: Start a child agent from this agent. A fork keeps this agent's harness and config — the harness is part of the identity it inherits and cannot be changed here.
forkPromptPlaceholder: Initial prompt for the forked agent…
restartDesc: Restart this agent, delivering a message as it wakes.
resurrectDesc: Bring this terminated agent back, delivering a message as it wakes.
terminateConfirm: Terminate Agent #{id}? The agent will finish its current turn, then exit.
restartConfirm: Restart Agent #{id}? The agent will finish its current turn, then come back as a fresh process.
forceKillConfirm: Force kill Agent #{id}? This SIGKILLs the process immediately — any in-flight turn is lost. Use this only when Terminate did not work.
statusOffline: Offline — machine unreachable or process lost
launchFailedCreated: Agent #{id} was created, but launch failed. Select it to retry.
hoverAwaitingReply: {count, plural, one {# awaiting reply} other {# awaiting reply}}
